SSRF allowlist permits a loopback mock server while private-network protection remains enabled

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig, SsrfPolicy

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        respect_robots_txt=False,
        ssrf=SsrfPolicy(allowlist=[{"type": "cidr", "value": "127.0.0.0/8"}], deny_private=True, max_redirects=5),
        ssrf_deny_private_explicit=True,
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.status_code)
    print(result.metadata.title)

asyncio.run(main())
```
